images.title: Simple setup
images.description: Add your Sendcloud API keys and integration ID.

images.title: Sendcloud tab on every order
images.description: Sendcloud order ID, parcel status, carrier and tracking link, kept up to date by Sendcloud's webhook.

images.title: Automatic fulfillment
images.description: When a label is created in Sendcloud, the order is fulfilled in Swell with the carrier and tracking number.

images.title: Shipment with Sendcloud tracking
images.description: The shipment the app creates has the carrier, tracking number and a note with the Sendcloud parcel and tracking link.
